The desk's typefaces, shipped with it so it looks the same on every
computer and with no internet (web/app/css/tokens.css loads them).

  barlow-semi-condensed-*.woff2   Barlow Semi Condensed 400 / 500 / 600 / 700,
                                  by Jeremy Tribby - every word and number on
                                  the desk.  SIL Open Font License 1.1 -
                                  LICENSE-barlow.txt
  ibm-plex-mono-*.woff2           IBM Plex Mono 400 / 500, by IBM - what is
                                  typed on the command line.  SIL Open Font
                                  License 1.1 - LICENSE-ibm-plex-mono.txt

From the @fontsource packages 5.3.0 (npm), unchanged: the "latin" and
"latin-ext" files of each weight.
